data.start-ssh.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
state=/opt/AcmePacket/.lab-ssh
install -d -m 755 "$state" /run/sshd /run/sdm-ssh
install -d -m 700 "$state/hostkeys"
install -m 644 /opt/sdm-ssh/authorized_keys /run/sdm-ssh/authorized_keys
if [ ! -f "$state/hostkeys/ssh_host_ed25519_key" ]; then
    ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f "$state/hostkeys/ssh_host_ed25519_key"
fi
/usr/sbin/sshd -t -f /opt/sdm-ssh/sshd_config
/usr/sbin/sshd -f /opt/sdm-ssh/sshd_config -E "$state/sshd.log"
data.sshd_config:
Port 22
ListenAddress 0.0.0.0
HostKey /opt/AcmePacket/.lab-ssh/hostkeys/ssh_host_ed25519_key
PidFile /run/sshd-sdm.pid
AuthorizedKeysFile /run/sdm-ssh/authorized_keys
AllowUsers nncentral
PermitRootLogin no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
AuthenticationMethods publickey
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
UsePAM no
StrictModes yes
PermitEmptyPasswords no
DisableForwarding yes
PermitTTY yes
PrintMotd no
Subsystem sftp internal-sftp
